protocol.title: L3 slot AdamW step/weight-decay decomposition

training.rule: factorially reset slot exp_avg, slot AdamW step, and/or cancel slot decoupled weight decay; preserve exp_avg_sq

protocol.primary_test: whether AdamW bias-correction step or decoupled weight decay explains residual slot interference after m1 reset
protocol.stop_rule: preserve second moment; no extra doses, arms, delays, seeds, or steps

diagnosis.interpretation_scope: Four frozen outcome-stratified endpoints; not a prevalence estimate.
diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed parameter-group intervention. Do not add groups, layers, seeds, steps, or post-hoc gates.
